description.zh: 带历史记录的表达式计算器，外加 Base64 / URL 编码和 MD5
description.en: An expression calculator with a running history, plus Base64 / URL encoding and MD5

help.zh: 关掉就隐藏列表并停止写入。已经存下的记录不会被删掉。
help.en: Off hides the list and stops writing it. Nothing already saved is deleted.

items.zh: 整条式子一起打，别一下一下按键：12*(3+4)-5。答案跟着输入实时更新。
items.en: Type the whole expression, not one key at a time: 12*(3+4)-5. The answer updates as you type.

items.zh: 回车就记下：答案挪进输入框，你可以接着算，这道算式进历史。
items.en: Enter commits it: the answer moves into the box so you can keep going, and the sum goes into the history.

items.zh: Esc 清空输入框。退格键就是它本来的样子 —— 这是一个文本框，不是键盘。
items.en: Esc clears the box. Backspace does what you expect — this is a text field, not a keypad.

items.zh: % 是取模，不是百分比：17%5 是 2。百分比就是写出来的 /100。
items.en: % is modulo, not percent: 17%5 is 2. A percentage is just /100 written out.

items.zh: 括号照常；开头允许负号，-3^2 是 -(3^2)。
items.en: Parentheses work as usual; a leading minus is allowed, and -3^2 is -(3^2).

items.zh: 点一行就把那个答案放回输入框 —— 算式还留在旁边看得见。
items.en: Click a row to put that answer back in the box — the sum stays visible next to it.

items.zh: 「历史条数」决定列表能放几行；「保留历史记录」关掉只是藏起来，不删。
items.en: History entries is how many rows fit; Keep a history off hides the list without deleting it.

items.zh: 历史按组件存，所以一个桌面上两个计算器共用同一份历史。
items.en: It is stored per widget, so two calculators on one desktop share one history.

items.zh: 编码把文字变成 Base64 或百分号编码的 URL，也能变回来。Base64 按 UTF-8，中文来回一趟不会坏。
items.en: Encode turns text into Base64 or a percent-encoded URL, and back. Base64 is UTF-8 safe, so Chinese survives the round trip.

items.zh: 哈希给出这段文字的 MD5 —— 小写十六进制。WebCrypto 没有 MD5，所以这一个是在组件里算的。
items.en: Hash gives you MD5 of the text — lowercase hex. WebCrypto has no MD5, so this one is computed in the widget.

items.zh: 复制把结果放进剪贴板。剪贴板权限是另一项：没有它就把文字选中。
items.en: Copy puts the result on the clipboard. The clipboard permission is separate: without it the text is selected instead.

items.zh: 解析器会点名告诉你两句：不能除以零和括号不配对。
items.en: Cannot divide by zero and Unbalanced parentheses are the two the parser will tell you about by name.

items.zh: 其余情况显示不认识的字符，并把那个字符写出来。
items.en: Anything else shows Unexpected character with the character in question.

changes.zh: 界面和说明都支持中文了：页签、按钮、报错和怎么用都跟着界面语言走。
changes.en: Interface and help are bilingual now: tabs, buttons, errors and the how-to all follow the interface language.

changes.zh: 标题栏给窗口按钮让出了位置，「哈希」页签不会再被盖住。
changes.en: The title bar now leaves room for the window buttons, so the Hash tab is no longer covered.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：表达式计算器，答案实时出，历史可以点。
changes.en: First release: expression calculator with live results and a clickable history.

changes.zh: Base64 和 URL 编码，两个方向都有，UTF-8 安全。
changes.en: Base64 and URL encoding, both directions, UTF-8 safe.

changes.zh: 输入文字的 MD5，在组件里算。
changes.en: MD5 of the typed text, computed in the widget.
